name: Heimerdinger
title: the Revered Inventor

Q.name: H-28 G Evolution Turret
Q.description: Heimerdinger constructs a Turret that attacks nearby enemies. Heimerdinger can have 3 turrets active at once. Turrets slowly build up charge. At max charge, they fire a stronger attack. If Heimerdinger gets too far away, his Turrets will deactivate after 8 seconds. This Ability has 3 charges.
Q.summary: Heimerdinger lays down a rapid-fire cannon turret equipped with a secondary pass-through beam attack (turrets deal half damage to towers).

W.name: Hextech Micro-Rockets
W.description: Heimerdinger unleashes a barrage of 5 rockets that deal 50/75/100/125/150 + 0.55×AP magic damage to the first enemy hit. Additional rocket hits deal reduced damage. Max Damage: 90/135/180/225/270 + 1.03×AP magic damage. Nearby Turrets gain 20% charge per rocket that hits a champion.
W.summary: Heimerdinger fires long-range rockets that converge on his cursor.

E.name: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade
E.description: Heimerdinger hurls a grenade that deals 60/100/140/180/220 + 0.6×AP magic damage in an area and Slows by (varies)% for 2 seconds. Enemies in the center are also Stunned for 1.5 seconds. Hitting a champion fully charges nearby Turrets.
E.summary: Heimerdinger lobs a grenade at a location, dealing damage to enemy units, as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units.

R.name: UPGRADE!!!
R.description: Heimerdinger upgrades his next non-ultimate Ability. H-28Q Apex Turret: Place an upgraded Turret for 8 seconds that doesn't count towards Heimerdinger's max turrets, deals 80/100/120 + 0.35×AP magic damage per shot and 100/140/180 + 0.7×AP magic damage per charged shot. Its attacks deal damage in an area, Slow by 25% for 2 seconds, and it is immune to crowd control. Hextech Rocket Swarm: Fires 4 waves of rockets that each deal 135/180/225 + 0.45×AP magic damage. Champions and jungle monsters hit by additional rockets take reduced damage, and minions take increased damage. Max Damage: 503/697.5/892 + 1.83×AP magic damage. CH-3X Lightning Grenade: Throws a bouncing grenade that discharges three times, dealing 100/200/300 + 0.6×AP magic damage. The Stun and Slow areas are larger. Recast: Cancel this Ability.
R.summary: Heimerdinger invents an upgrade, causing his next spell to have increased effects.

Passive.name: Hextech Affinity
Passive.description: Gain Move Speed while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger.
Passive.summary: Gain Move Speed while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Heimerdinger is a ranged mage who places turrets with H-28 G Evolution Turret to control lanes and zones. He plays mid, top or support, pushing waves and winning fights in areas filled with his turrets.
strengths: Turrets give strong lane control and damage from early levels.
CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade stuns in the center and slows around it.
UPGRADE!!! gives a big turret, a rocket swarm or a large stun grenade.
Strong in areas where his turrets are set up.
Hextech Micro-Rockets charge turrets when they hit.
weaknesses: Turrets deactivate if he moves too far away.
Weak against long-range champions who outrange turrets.

curve.lvl1: strong – a turret in lane zones the enemy off the wave
curve.lvl2: strong – W rockets plus turrets out-trade most mid laners
curve.lvl3: strong – E stun into charged turret shots
curve.lvl6: strong – UPGRADE!!! gives an Apex Turret, a rocket swarm or a big stun grenade
curve.items: medium – first item: Liandry's Torment or Luden's Companion
curve.late: okay – deadly in a prepared area, weak away from it

profile.curveNote: Heimerdinger is strong from level 1 thanks to turrets, and stronger at 6 with UPGRADE!!!.

keyAbilities.answers: None. Heimerdinger has no spell shield or dodge.

Passive.notes: Hextech Affinity: move speed near allied towers and his turrets.

Q.notes: H-28 G Evolution Turret: turrets that attack and charge up.

W.answer: Dodge sideways, or block with a projectile block.
W.notes: Hextech Micro-Rockets: rockets that charge turrets on hit.

E.answer: Dodge the grenade; Cleanse/QSS removes the stun.
E.notes: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade: slows the area, stuns in the center.

R.notes: UPGRADE!!!: upgrades his next basic ability.

profile.windowAgainst: Heimerdinger's window is when his turrets are down or away: fight him outside his turret zone.
